title: Fat-dissolving injections in Cairo
description: Read about fat-dissolving injections and mesolipolysis in Cairo, including assessment of localised fat, swelling and risks specific to each treatment area.
answer: Fat-dissolving injections and mesolipolysis are discussed for selected small areas of localised fat. They do not treat obesity. Adults can ask about the planned substance, its evidence for the area and alternatives at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. An examination distinguishes fat from loose skin or another swelling.
preparation: Any new lump, previous operation or infection in the area needs evaluation first. Ask about suitability for the precise site.
howPerformed: The team examines the area and explains the substance, site-specific risks and alternatives before any injection.
followup: Swelling, firmness and tenderness can affect daily activities. Arrange review for persistent numbness, pain or skin changes.
risks: Fat-dissolving agents can damage skin and nearby structures, including nerves. Evidence and risks depend on substance and site.
